<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD file for libresprite-git follows standard Arch Linux packaging practices. The source is fetched from the official LibreSprite GitHub repository (https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite.git), which matches the project's declared upstream URL. The `sha256sums=('SKIP')` is appropriate and required for VCS-based packages. The `pkgver()` function uses standard `git describe` to derive version information. The `prepare()` function runs `git submodule update --init --recursive --depth=1`, which is a legitimate build requirement for projects using git submodules. The `build()` and `package()` functions use standard cmake/Ninja workflows. The `package()` function performs legitimate post-install modifications to avoid conflicts with the aseprite package by renaming and editing the mime type XML file. No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, dangerous commands, or data exfiltration patterns were found.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>Standard AUR PKGBUILD with no malicious indicators detected.</summary>
